In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''[[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]]''' visited the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] known as the [[Twirling Twi'lek]]. The Whiphid attacked and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the notorious [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="Jango" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This individual was created for [[Star Wars: Jango Fett (one-shot)|''Star Wars: Jango Fett'']], published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] in [[2002]]. The [[Star Wars comic books|comic issue]] was written by [[Ron Marz]] and illustrated by [[Tom Fowler]].
